headline: Committee reviewed revenue ideas, PILOTs, enterprise funds, CHARM facilities, and health insurance savings options for reducing the city deficit.
summary: The Deficit Reduction Committee discussed public engagement plans, new revenue ideas including cannabis revenue, harbormaster mooring fees, and PILOT agreements with tax-exempt institutions. Members also reviewed enterprise funds for the golf course, harbor, and airport, CHARM recycling facilities, municipal utilities regionalization, and potential health insurance changes including a switch to the state GIC plan. The committee agreed that paid parking on Lothrop Street is a recommended new revenue source, but most other ideas remain under research with no final decisions made.
decisions: Agreed unanimously among those present that paid parking on Lothrop St. is a definite recommendation for new revenue.
Decided against eliminating Regional Dispatch internally this year, per prior budget meetings discussion.
